data.case_title: Musterfield Exchange Programme – Housing application deadline
data.explanation: This letter from the Musterfield Exchange Programme welcomes you to the exchange programme and asks you to send back the completed housing application form by the date shown in the letter. If the form arrives after that date, you will not lose your place in the programme, but you will be moved to the waiting list for housing instead of getting your preferred placement, so it is worth sending it in on time. No payment is being requested in this letter.

items.consequence: Forms that arrive after the deadline will be placed on the waiting list instead of being processed on time.
